description: This file defines a class BookingWebhookFactory for creating webhook payloads related to booking events, including handling cancellations. It includes type definitions for payload structures and helper functions.

classes.name: BookingWebhookFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating webhook payloads related to booking events, especially cancellations.

methods.name: createCancelledEventPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload for a cancelled booking event, extending the base payload with cancellation-specific details.

methods.name: createBasePayload
methods.description: Generates a base webhook payload with common booking details.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type of the event based on eventSlug or title.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the booking.

methods.name: getDestinationCalendar
methods.description: Returns the destination calendar as an array if present.

methods.name: getCustomInputs
methods.description: Returns custom inputs if they are an object but not an array.
